transcript: How to set battery optimization in iPhone 13 to 80%?
response:
The iPhone thirteen does not have a direct setting to cap charging at exactly eighty percent. However, you can enable Optimized Battery Charging, which is designed to reduce battery wear by delaying charging past eighty percent until your iPhone predicts you will need to use it. To enable this feature, go to Settings, then Battery, then Battery Health & Charging, and toggle on Optimized Battery Charging.
